title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #11

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How can you keep in touch with a relative far away? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore
   B. Forget
   C. Call, send a message or a gift
   D. Insult

2. Which of these do angels do? (1 mark)
   A. They are Allah's daughters
   B. They eat and sleep
   C. They never disobey Allah
   D. They sometimes disobey

3. What is a nullifier of wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. A drink
   B. Something that breaks wudhu
   C. A prayer
   D. A step of wudhu

4. Which surah tells us not to worship what the disbelievers worship? (1 mark)
   A. An-Nasr
   B. Al-Ikhlas
   C. Al-Fatiha
   D. Al-Kafirun

5. Who is the best example of good character for Muslims? (1 mark)
   A. Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.)
   B. A rich businessman
   C. A game character
   D. A film star

6. What is integrity in media use? (1 mark)
   A. Doing right even when nobody is watching
   B. Copying work
   C. Hiding
   D. Cheating

7. Which of these fits the Islamic code of dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Very tight
   B. Loose, clean and modest
   C. See-through
   D. Torn on purpose

8. What does "akhlaq" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fasting
   B. Prayer times
   C. Character and manners
   D. Direction of prayer

9. What is takbiratul ihram? (1 mark)
   A. Saying "Allahu Akbar" to begin the prayer
   B. Reciting Fatiha
   C. Bowing
   D. Saying salaam

10. What does adornment mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding
   B. Fasting
   C. Praying
   D. Making oneself look neat and nice

11. What should a Muslim say before eating? (1 mark)
   A. Subhanallah
   B. Astaghfirullah
   C. Bismillah
   D. Alhamdulillah

12. Which of these is a positive use of the internet? (1 mark)
   A. Finding information for a school project with permission
   B. Watching harmful videos
   C. Bullying
   D. Meeting strangers

13. What is tajweed? (1 mark)
   A. A type of charity
   B. Giving each letter of the Qur'an its proper pronunciation
   C. The call to prayer
   D. A kind of prayer mat

14. Eid al-Adha reminds us of the obedience of (1 mark)
   A. Nuh and Lut
   B. Musa and Harun
   C. Ibrahim and Ismail
   D. Adam and Hawa

15. How does physical fitness help worship? (1 mark)
   A. It removes the need to pray
   B. It makes prayer shorter
   C. It makes standing, bowing and fasting easier
   D. It replaces zakat

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe the manners a Muslim should follow when reading the Qur'an. (3 marks)

17. Write the hadith on physical fitness given in your syllabus. (2 marks)

18. Describe how to show patience to an elderly parent or grandparent. (3 marks)

19. Suggest three ways to keep in touch with relatives who live far away. (3 marks)

20. Explain how physical fitness helps a Muslim in worship and in daily life. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Call, send a message or a gift
   Keep contact.

2. C — They never disobey Allah
   The Qur'an says they do what they are commanded.

3. B — Something that breaks wudhu
   It cancels the state of wudhu.

4. D — Al-Kafirun
   Al-Kafirun states this firmly and ends "For you your religion, for me mine".

5. A — Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.)
   The Qur'an praises his great character.

6. A — Doing right even when nobody is watching
   Allah sees everything.

7. B — Loose, clean and modest
   Clothes should cover properly.

8. C — Character and manners
   Akhlaq means moral character.

9. A — Saying "Allahu Akbar" to begin the prayer
   It starts the prayer.

10. D — Making oneself look neat and nice
   Adornment is beautifying.

11. C — Bismillah
   We begin by mentioning Allah's name.

12. A — Finding information for a school project with permission
   Learning is good.

13. B — Giving each letter of the Qur'an its proper pronunciation
   Tajweed means reciting the Qur'an with correct rules of pronunciation.

14. C — Ibrahim and Ismail
   It remembers the sacrifice of a ram.

15. C — It makes standing, bowing and fasting easier
   A healthy body helps us do our duties.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Be clean and make wudhu if possible, sit calmly, seek Allah's protection from Shaytan and say Bismillah, and read slowly and clearly with tajweed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct manner, up to 3.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Teach your children swimming, archery and horse riding.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the skills and 1 mark for the instruction to teach children.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen without complaining, help them to walk and eat, speak gently.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Call, send messages, send gifts, visit in holidays, attend family events.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (4 marks)
   Answer: It makes prayer postures, fasting and walking to the mosque easier. It also gives strength for work and helping others.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for worship points and 2 marks for daily life points.
